verses.en: Now Joshua was old and stricken in years; and the LORD said unto him, Thou art old and stricken in years, and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed.
verses.pt: Era Josué já velho e avançado em anos, quando lhe disse o Senhor: Já estás velho e avançado em anos, e ainda fica muitíssima terra para se possuir.
verses.en_web: Now Joshua was old and well advanced in years. Yahweh said to him, “You are old and advanced in years, and there remains yet very much land to be possessed.
verses.en_bbe: Now Joshua was old and full of years; and the Lord said to him, You are old and full of years, and there is still very much land to be taken.

verses.en: This is the land that yet remaineth: all the borders of the Philistines, and all Geshuri,
verses.pt: A terra que ainda fica é esta: todas as regiões dos filisteus, bem como todas as dos gesureus,
verses.en_web: “This is the land that still remains: all the regions of the Philistines, and all the Geshurites;
verses.en_bbe: This is the land which is still to be taken: all the country of the Philistines, and all the Geshurites;

verses.en: From Sihor, which is before Egypt, even unto the borders of Ekron northward, which is counted to the Canaanite: five lords of the Philistines; the Gazathites, and the Ashdothites, the Eshkalonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avites:
verses.pt: desde Sior, que está defronte do Egito, até o termo de Ecrom para o norte, que se tem como pertencente aos cananeus; os cinco chefes dos filisteus; o gazeu, o asdodeu, o asqueloneu, o giteu, e o ecroneu; também os aveus;
verses.en_web: from the Shihor, which is before Egypt, even to the border of Ekron northward, which is counted as Canaanite; the five lords of the Philistines; the Gazites, and the Ashdodites, the Ashkelonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avvim,
verses.en_bbe: From the Shihor, which is before Egypt, to the edge of Ekron to the north, which is taken to be Canaanite property: the five chiefs of the Philistines; the Gazites, and the Ashdodites, the Ashkelonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites, as well as the Avvim;

verses.en: From the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that is beside the Sidonians, unto Aphek, to the borders of the Amorites:
verses.pt: no sul toda a terra, dos cananeus, e Meara, que pertence aos sidônios, até Afeca, até o termo dos amorreus;
verses.en_web: on the south; all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that belongs to the Sidonians, to Aphek, to the border of the Amorites;
verses.en_bbe: On the south: all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah which is the property of the Zidonians, to Aphek, as far as the limit of the Amorites:

verses.en: And the land of the Giblites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrising, from Baal-gad under mount Hermon unto the entering into Hamath.
verses.pt: como também a terra dos Gebalitas, e todo o Líbano para o nascente do sol, desde Baal-Gade, ao pé do monte Hermom, até a entrada de Hamate;
verses.en_web: and the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrise, from Baal Gad under Mount Hermon to the entrance of Hamath;
verses.en_bbe: And the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, looking east, from Baal-gad under Mount Hermon as far as Hamath:

verses.en: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon unto Misrephoth-maim, and all the Sidonians, them will I drive out from before the children of Israel: only divide thou it by lot unto the Israelites for an inheritance, as I have commanded thee.
verses.pt: todos os habitantes da região montanhosa desde o Líbano até Misrefote-Maim, a saber, todos os sidônios. Eu os lançarei de diante dos filhos de Israel; tão-somente reparte a terra a Israel por herança, como já te mandei.
verses.en_web: all the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, even all the Sidonians. I will drive them out from before the children of Israel. Just allocate it to Israel for an inheritance, as I have commanded you.
verses.en_bbe: All the people of the hill-country from Lebanon to Misrephoth-maim, all the Zidonians; them will I send out from before the children of Israel: only make division of it to Israel for a heritage, as I have given you orders to do.

verses.en: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes, and the half tribe of Manasseh,
verses.pt: Reparte, pois, agora esta terra por herança às nove tribos, e à meia tribo de Manassés.
verses.en_web: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”
verses.en_bbe: So now make division of this land for a heritage to the nine tribes, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

verses.en: With whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them;
verses.pt: Com a outra meia tribo os rubenitas e os gaditas já haviam recebido a sua herança do Jordão para o oriente, a qual Moisés, servo do Senhor, lhes tinha dado:
verses.en_web: With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of Yahweh gave them:
verses.en_bbe: With him the Reubenites and the Gadites have been given their heritage, which Moses gave them, on the east side of Jordan, as Moses, the servant of the Lord, gave them;

verses.en: From Aroer, that is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon;
verses.pt: desde Aroer, que está à borda do vale do Arnom, e a cidade que está no meio do vale, e todo o planalto de Medeba até Dibom;
verses.en_web: from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain of Medeba to Dibon;
verses.en_bbe: From Aroer, on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the town in the middle of the valley, and all the table-land from Medeba to Dibon;

verses.en: And all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, unto the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.pt: e todas as cidades de Siom, rei dos amorreus, que reinou em Hesbom, até o termo dos amonitas;
verses.en_web: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, to the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.en_bbe: And all the towns of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who was ruling in Heshbon, to the limits of the children of Ammon;

verses.en: And Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan unto Salcah;
verses.pt: e Gileade, e o território dos gesureus e dos maacateus, e todo o monte Hermom, e toda a Basã até Salca;
verses.en_web: and Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan to Salecah;
verses.en_bbe: And Gilead, and the land of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan to Salecah;

verses.en: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan, which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants: for these did Moses smite, and cast them out.
verses.pt: todo o reino de Ogue em Basã, que reinou em Astarote e em Edrei (ele era dos refains que ficaram); pois que Moisés os feriu e expulsou.
verses.en_web: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (the same was left of the remnant of the Rephaim); for Moses attacked these, and drove them out.
verses.en_bbe: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who was ruling in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (he was one of the last of the Rephaim); these did Moses overcome, driving them out of their country.

verses.en: Nevertheless the children of Israel expelled not the Geshurites, nor the Maachathites: but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.
verses.pt: Contudo os filhos de Israel não expulsaram os gesureus nem os maacateus, os quais ficaram habitando no meio de Israel até o dia de hoje.
verses.en_web: Nevertheless the children of Israel didn’t drive out the Geshurites, nor the Maacathites: but Geshur and Maacath live within Israel to this day.
verses.en_bbe: However, the people of Israel did not send out the Geshurites, or the Maacathites: but Geshur and Maacath are living among Israel to this day.

verses.en: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave none inheritance; the sacrifices of the LORD God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance, as he said unto them.
verses.pt: Tão-somente à tribo de Levi não deu herança; as ofertas queimadas ao Senhor, Deus de Israel, são a sua herança, como lhe tinha dito.
verses.en_web: Only he gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The offerings of Yahweh, the God of Israel, made by fire are his inheritance, as he spoke to him.
verses.en_bbe: Only to the tribe of Levi he gave no heritage; the offerings of the Lord, the God of Israel, made by fire are his heritage, as he said to him.

verses.en: And Moses gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben inheritance according to their families.
verses.pt: Assim Moisés deu herança à tribo dos filhos de Rúben conforme as suas famílias.
verses.en_web: Moses gave to the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their families.
verses.en_bbe: And Moses gave their heritage to the tribe of Reuben by their families.

verses.en: And their coast was from Aroer, that is on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba;
verses.pt: E foi o seu território desde Aroer, que está à borda do vale do Amom, e a cidade que está no meio do vale, e todo o planalto junto a Medeba;
verses.en_web: Their border was from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain by Medeba;
verses.en_bbe: Their limit was from Aroer, on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the town in the middle of the valley, and all the table-land by Medeba;

verses.en: Heshbon, and all her cities that are in the plain; Dibon, and Bamoth-baal, and Beth-baal-meon,
verses.pt: Hesbom, e todas as suas cidades que estão no planalto; Dibom, Bamote-Baal e Bete-Baal-Meom;
verses.en_web: Heshbon, and all its cities that are in the plain; Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,
verses.en_bbe: Heshbon and all her towns in the table-land; Dibon, and Bamoth-baal, and Beth-baal-meon;

verses.en: And Jahaza, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,
verses.pt: Jaza, Qa espada até serem consumidos, então todo o Israel
verses.en_web: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,
verses.en_bbe: And Jahaz, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath;

verses.en: And Kirjathaim, and Sibmah, and Zareth-shahar in the mount of the valley,
verses.pt: Quiriataim, Sibma e Zerete-Saar, no monte do vale;
verses.en_web: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar in the mount of the valley,
verses.en_bbe: And Kiriathaim, and Sibmah, and Zereth-shahar in the mountain of the valley;

verses.en: And Beth-peor, and Ashdoth-pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth,
verses.pt: Bete-Peor, as faldas de Pisga e Bete-Jesimote;
verses.en_web: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, Beth Jeshimoth,
verses.en_bbe: And Beth-peor, and the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth;

verses.en: And all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, which were dukes of Sihon, dwelling in the country.
verses.pt: todas as cidades do planalto, e todo o reino de Siom, rei dos amorreus, que reinou em Hesbom, a quem Moisés feriu juntamente com os príncipes de Midiã: Evi, Requem, Zur, Hur e Reba, príncipes de Siom, que moravam naquela terra.
verses.en_web: all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses struck with the chiefs of Midian, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the princes of Sihon, who lived in the land.
verses.en_bbe: And all the towns of the table-land, and all the kingdom of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who was ruling in Heshbon, whom Moses overcame, together with the chiefs of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, the chiefs of Sihon, who were living in the land.

verses.en: Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them.
verses.pt: Também ao adivinho Balaão, filho de Beor, os filhos de Israel mataram à espada, juntamente com os demais que por eles foram mortos.
verses.en_web: The children of Israel also killed Balaam the son of Beor, the soothsayer, with the sword, among the rest of their slain.
verses.en_bbe: And Balaam, the son of Beor, the prophet, the children of Israel put to death with the sword.

verses.en: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan, and the border thereof. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families, the cities and the villages thereof.
verses.pt: E ficou sendo o Jordão o termo dos filhos de Rúben. Essa região, com as suas cidades e aldeias, foi a herança dos filhos de Rúben, segundo as suas famílias.
verses.en_web: The border of the children of Reuben was the bank of the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families, the cities and its villages.
verses.en_bbe: And the limit of the children of Reuben was the edge of Jordan. This was the heritage of the children of Reuben by their families, with its towns and its unwalled places.

verses.en: And Moses gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad, even unto the children of Gad according to their families.
verses.pt: Também deu Moisés herança à tribo de Gade, aos filhos de Gade, segundo as suas famílias.
verses.en_web: Moses gave to the tribe of Gad, to the children of Gad, according to their families.
verses.en_bbe: And Moses gave their heritage to the tribe of Gad by their families.

verses.en: And their coast was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, unto Aroer that is before Rabbah;
verses.pt: E foi o seu território Jazer, e todas as cidades de Gileade, e metade da terra dos amonitas, até Aroer, que está defronte de Rabá;
verses.en_web: Their border was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, to Aroer that is near Rabbah;
verses.en_bbe: And their limit was Jazer, and all the towns of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, to Aroer before Rabbah;

verses.en: And from Heshbon unto Ramath-mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir;
verses.pt: e desde Hesbom até Ramá-Mizpe, e Betonim, e desde Maanaim até o termo de Debir;
verses.en_web: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir;
verses.en_bbe: And from Heshbon to Ramath-mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim to the edge of Debir;

verses.en: And in the valley, Beth-aram, and Beth-nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and his border, even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward.
verses.pt: e no vale, Bete-Arã, Bete-Ninra, Sucote e Zafom, resto do reino de Siom, rei de Hesbom, tendo o Jordão por termo, até a extremidade do mar de Quinerete, do Jordão para o oriente.
verses.en_web: and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, the Jordan’s bank, to the uttermost part of the sea of Chinnereth beyond the Jordan eastward.
verses.en_bbe: And in the valley, Beth-haram, and Beth-nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon, king of Heshbon, having Jordan for its limit, to the end of the sea of Chinnereth on the east side of Jordan.

verses.en: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families, the cities, and their villages.
verses.pt: Essa região, com as suas cidades e aldeias, foi a herança dos filhos da Gade, segundo as suas famílias.
verses.en_web: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and its villages.
verses.en_bbe: This is the heritage of the children of Gad by their families, with its towns and its unwalled places

verses.en: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh: and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.
verses.pt: Também deu Moisés herança à meia tribo de Manassés; a qual foi repartida à meia tribo dos filhos de Manassés segundo as suas famílias.
verses.en_web: Moses gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh. It was for the half-tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families.
verses.en_bbe: And Moses gave their heritage to the half-tribe of Manasseh by their families.

verses.en: And their coast was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, threescore cities:
verses.pt: Foi o seu território desde Maanaim; toda a Basã, todo o reino de Ogue, rei de Basã, e todas as aldeias de Jair, que estão em Basã, sessenta ao todo;
verses.en_web: Their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities.
verses.en_bbe: And their limit was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og, king of Bashan, and all Havvoth-Jair, in Bashan, sixty towns;

verses.en: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families.
verses.pt: e metade de Gileade, e Astarote, e Edrei, cidades do reino de Ogue, em Basã, foram para os filhos de Maquir, filho de Manassés, isto é, para a metade dos filhos de Maquir, segundo as suas famílias.
verses.en_web: Half Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even for the half of the children of Machir according to their families.
verses.en_bbe: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, towns of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir, the son of Manasseh, for half of the children of Machir by their families.

verses.en: These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.
verses.pt: Isso é o que Moisés repartiu em herança nas planícies de Moabe, do Jordão para o oriente, na altura de Jericó.
verses.en_web: These are the inheritances which Moses distributed in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan at Jericho, eastward.
verses.en_bbe: These are the heritages of which Moses made distribution in the lowlands of Moab, on the other side of Jordan in Jericho, to the east.

verses.en: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not any inheritance: the LORD God of Israel was their inheritance, as he said unto them.
verses.pt: Contudo, à tribo de Levi Moisés não deu herança; o Senhor, Deus de Israel, é a sua herança, como lhe tinha dito.
verses.en_web: But Moses gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. Yahweh, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he spoke to them.
verses.en_bbe: But to the tribe of Levi Moses gave no heritage: the Lord, the God of Israel, is their heritage, as he said to them.
